snippet.title: ZX Spectrum / Weasel Willy 4,802
snippet.description:
Lvl Up submission 
ZX Spectrum (Emulated)
Weasel Willy
4,802
Firebird Software, 1985

Released on a compilation called "Don't Buy This", with the subtitle "Five of the worst games ever".

It was even released on 1st of April, 1985 :-)

You got 5 bad games at the price of £2.50, but I  must admit with my simple taste, that I at least like this Willy game :-)

Did you buy this back then, AND WHY?

#Sinclair #ZXSpectrum #WeaseWilly #FirebirdSoftware #DontBuyThis #RetroGaming
